violations.description: Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored in a proper location to be protected from contamination. Items stored on ground. Store items off from ground.
Plumbing system. — --Plumbing system was not designed, constructed, operated and/or maintained according to regulation. Hand washing sink non-operational. Replace battery for water pump.

Handwashing lavatories. — --Handwashing lavatory was not provided in sufficient number and/or not accessible to allow convenient use by employees. No handwashing sink provided at the time of inspection due to a bad battery. Replace battery.

Design and construction of floors, walls, and ceilings. — --Floors were not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable. No flooring provided. Some sort of outdoor carpet or tarp on ground in booth should be provided when set up on grass.

Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --Cloth for wiping food spills was not stored in sanitizing solution (at proper concentration) between uses. Bucket with wiping cloth was found with 0ppm chlorine. Wiping cloth solutions should be at least 100ppm.

Sanitizing solution testing devices. — --Test strip or kit that accurately measures the sanitizing concentration was not provided. Test strips were not available for testing chlorine sanitizing solutions for washing dishes. Testing strips should be available to assure proper strengths are being used for sanitizing.
